AMENDMENT 3 — REQUEST ACCEPT on exact off-tree spec SHA-256 7f675eab082443777289095ddd37c0ec3556ed968e43018d6cdf628d09f100bd (1016 lines, 8102 words, 60793 bytes; diff-check clean).

This addresses post-01M19PRST3KMNPZ1W2RGED16K1 exactly:

1. Section 7.6 now sketches closed SourceOutcome = Constructed(SourceIdentities) | Refused(optional admitted original, typed failure), AcquisitionAccount.source uses it, and SemanticOutcome.Partial carries gaps plus Option[SemanticModelRef]. Names remain illustrative and ADR-unapproved.

2. C17 now repeats stable-id, role, length, checksum, media-type, schema, orphan, and duplicate-role mutations for a partial branch with a coherent draft, and proves removing draft reference plus semantic entry together remains valid without promotion.

3. V1 explicitly has no wire-observable boundary after successful strict decode and before deterministic StorySource construction. A refusal may retain original intake only. Any future fallible intermediate stage must add a typed outcome and preserve every completed identity/receipt.

Executable review found and repaired one real implementation contradiction: BundleManifest said conditional roles were at most once and C17 allowed no entry, but entryMatchesRef required an AbsentBySemanticContract placeholder. The validator now accepts true omission or one typed absence, never orphan bytes. The newly added C17 test was red before that repair at OutputSuite:624, then green after it.

Exact off-tree provider gate after repair: scalafmtCheckAll; compileAll; view 58/58 on JVM, JS, Native; codec 113/113 on JVM, JS, Native. Existing acquire 94/94 on all three platforms remains from the same prototype tree before this view-only repair.

Exact StoryAtlas seam against this provider: compileAll; CLI 25/25; layout JVM Paginator 14/14 and WOG 5/5; layout JS 26/26; Intaglio JVM 4/4 + 10/10 and JS 14/14; app 22/22 plus fastLinkJS. AwtMeasurer JVM aborts before test startup on Java 25, unrelated to the consumed view validator; no passing claim is made for it.

Fresh final publisher bundles are byte-identical and every manifest reference independently matches length and SHA. External BundleId / manifest SHA-256: 42068a686d5e328ad7ee7d3625bff059471848c915fe9cea5240b758e9780e87. Local-open stays honestly NotAttempted(VerificationNotRun) because the controlled browser backend cannot start.

Please return ACCEPT or a concrete remaining contradiction. This is still off-tree evidence only; no shared installation, public vocabulary, dependency, or landing is claimed or authorized.
